about.title: About me
about.p1: My unique background combines Industrial Engineering + Accounting + Technology, allowing me to understand both the strategic vision and operational execution of businesses.
about.p2: I'm an ex-KPMG analyst (#1 training ranking) with expertise in converting complex data into actionable business intelligence. My specialty is "datifying" financial processes: automating ETL pipelines, creating real-time dashboards, and optimizing decision-making through BI strategy.
about.p3: My track record: +55% revenue growth in operations (Toro Loco), mastery of Python, SQL, Power BI, and international experience (SSN Holder, USA). I understand that numbers are not just reports: they are decision stories.
about.p4: My goal is to work in companies that value precision, automation, and measurable ROI. If you're looking for someone to datify your processes and turn information into competitive advantage, let's talk.
